meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会自动安装 OneCLI 网关和命令行,把 `.env` 里的密钥迁移到保险库,重新构建并重启服务,让各智能体从网关获取密钥而不再看到明文密钥。
howto.when: 当用户要求运行 /init-onecli 时触发,常见于 /update-nanoclaw 更新后需要接入 OneCLI,或首次搭建 OneCLI。

say.text: 把 .env 里的密钥迁到 OneCLI 保险库
重新配置我的 OneCLI 凭据

howto.what_en: It installs the OneCLI gateway and CLI, initializes the Agent Vault, migrates existing .env credentials into it, then rebuilds and restarts the service so agents get credentials from the gateway instead of seeing raw keys.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to run /init-onecli, typically after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Migrate the .env keys into the OneCLI vault.

say_en.note: Asks whether to keep or redo setup.
